title: Pulse's filters in one button: lists, Show, Senders, Levels, Group by and saved views
why: Jason, 2026-11-20 (design/table-standard.md, his note and its answers): "the group, filter, box drop down are kind of hard to work with". The admin's Pulse now has one filter button ("Inbox · All (n) ▾") whose panel opens under it and holds your lists, Show, Senders and Levels (ticks that apply at once, each with how many your other choices leave, a greyed 0 for none), Group by and Saved views. The panel stays open so filters combine, and closes with ×, Esc or a click outside. What's on shows as tags beside the button, each with × (Clear all for every one). The From and level funnels in the column headers and the centred "Show these …" box are gone; sorting stays on the headers. Grouped, a group of 3 rows or fewer opens by itself, what you open or close is remembered on the device, and Open all / Close all sit beside the button. Saved views are kept with the account across devices (a new table, pulse_views: the person, the name, the filters); × removes one, with Undo. On a wide screen the bell, Your day, Quick actions and Settings say their names. No outside calls, no cost.
